rul.procedure: rul_hours = postprocess(rul_head[0]) * cadence_hours (median spacing of the last <=48 window times); stage = postprocess(rul_head[2]). RUL is meaningful when stage >= 2 and the bearing is the faulted one. CADENCE: the head is trained on windows spaced 10 min apart ([SIMULATION; endpoints resampled from rig windows, 1 bearing/fault, curve shape + life variance assumed]); hosts must feed one window per snapshot with t20_ms spaced accordingly.

stage: rul_head[2] from the z head: 1 if z < -0.08 else min(6, 2 + floor(5 clip(z,0,1))); deployed: postprocess.stage (median 1, max_step None)

postprocess.applies_to: contract v3b direct_v3 heads; per bearing, causal, one update per 'ok' window (after warm-up)
postprocess.state_reset: on engine reset / new bearing stream (same as the window buffers)

stage.input: s_raw = round(rul_head[2]) (rul_head[2] is an exact integer-valued float)
stage.procedure: push s_raw into a FIFO of the last median_window raw stages; m = sorted(fifo)[(len(fifo)-1)//2] (lower median while the FIFO is not full); if first output: s = m; else if max_step is null: s = m; else s = s_prev + clamp(m - s_prev, -max_step, +max_step); s_prev = s; health_stage = s

rul_filter.procedure: if first output or alpha >= 1: r = r_raw; else prior = max(r_prev - 1, 0); r = exp(alpha*ln(1+r_raw) + (1-alpha)*ln(1+prior)) - 1; r_prev = r (UNscaled); compute in float64

rul_scale.procedure: rul_windows = r * (scale_if_stage_le_2 if health_stage <= 2 else scale_if_stage_ge_3) using the post-processed health_stage of the same window; rul_hours = rul_windows * cadence_hours
